rubric_provenance.method: Manual single-pass authoring while implementing this benchmark layer; provisional until independently re-reviewed.

required_facts.description: The per-attempt request timeout passed to session.get changes from 30 seconds to 5 seconds.
max_attempts changes from 1 (no retry) to 4, so the loop now retries the request up to three additional times after a TimeoutError before giving up.

Combining the shorter per-attempt timeout with more attempts and a fixed 1-second sleep between attempts changes the worst-case total time before fetch_with_retry raises TimeoutError: previously up to about 30s (1 attempt), now up to about 5*4 + 1*3 = 23s across four attempts. This numeric implication follows directly from the two changed constants and the unchanged loop/sleep structure.
